title: animated-svg-2d widget params
description: A self-contained play/pause animation engine. The renderer supplies a Play/Pause button, a scrub slider, and a requestAnimationFrame loop that advances a normalized time t in [0,1] and calls the author's frame(t); the author writes only the per-frame math + redraw into params.bodyScript (it receives the SVG group G, the svg node, the readout `out`, and the page-global $/SVG helpers). The gesture is 'play' — a dimension the corpus otherwise lacks. A non-HTML frontend can ignore renderScript and drive its own clock from the schema (steps/durationMs/loop).

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper. The play button and scrub slider derive their ids from it (widgetId+'-play', widgetId+'-scrub').

svgId.description: DOM id for the <svg> canvas the author draws into.

outputId.description: DOM id for the .readout element the author writes per-frame text into.

svgTitle.description: Accessible <title> inside the SVG. Defaults to title.

steps.description: Number of discrete scrub positions (slider granularity). Defaults to 120.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of one full t:0->1 play pass. Defaults to 4000.

loop.description: Whether play wraps from t=1 back to t=0. Defaults to true.

autoplay.description: Start playing on load (only if requestAnimationFrame is available). Defaults to false.

playLabel.description: Text for the play control in the paused state. Defaults to '▶ Play'.

pauseLabel.description: Text for the play control in the playing state. Defaults to '⏸ Pause'.

outputInitial.description: Initial readout HTML before the first frame paints. Defaults to a non-breaking space.

bodyScript.description: Author JS defining `function frame(t){ ... }` with t in [0,1]. It clears+fills the SVG group `G`, writes `out`, and may use the page-global $/SVG helpers and the constant STEPS. Runs once at t=0 on load; then on every rAF tick and scrub. Must not start its own timers.
